AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Animal Feed: Hay? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix? (1 mark)

16. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

17. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids
